rationale: Both responses use the same Sophie Germain-style factorization, x^4 + 1/4 = (1/4)(2x^2-2x+1)(2x^2+2x+1). Both correctly evaluate it at 2k and 2k-1 (I checked that the factors 8k^2-4k+1 and 8k^2-12k+5 are right), cancel the shared factor and telescope using 8k^2-12k+5 = 8(k-1)^2+4(k-1)+1 to get 8n^2+4n+1. A names the sequence a_k, which makes the telescoping notation tidy, while B writes the shifted form out explicitly. Both have the same rigor and clarity.
